Product issue: On the sign-in code step, 'Resend code' and 'Use a different email' are 16 px-tall stacked text buttons, on the edge of the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception: they fail it in the iPhone 15 WebKit emulation (297×16) and pass it in Chromium (Pixel 7, 316×16), about a pixel of line height apart — confirm on a real iPhone before filing it as iPhone-specific. descriptionHtml:
Suggestion A1 · accessibility · not counted as a bug (was P2): accessibility is not asked for by any UAT item or ticket, so this is a suggestion, not a bug (Quinn 2026-10-14)

Buttons, inputs and dropdowns have no accessible name (Nursing Home +, settings, back, close X, task done/delete, medication status dropdown); also some focus jumps to the top and small tap targets

Tickets: — · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local (visual check)

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-06/S24b, TC-03/S21, TC-11/S20, TC-12/S20, TC-14/S22, TC-19/S21, TC-21/S20, TC-22/S20

Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S21 axe and a design look on the sign-in screen, the agreements screen and Settings, on desktop and phone profiles

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 The sign-in screen says 'Round Companion' (not 'RoundAI') and 'Sign in or create an account with a code sent to your email'. (TFA-94513 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress
  • U7 On first sign-in, before any AI feature can be used, one agreements screen shows: the AI consent, links to the Terms of Use and the BAA, and two checkboxes (the agreement and the authorization attest … (UAT OAT-01 step 7; UAT OAT-01 Expected; TFA-94700 AC 7; TFA-94700 AC 8; TFA-94700 AC 9; TFA-94700 AC 11; UAT 3.3)
  • T12 The Settings and agreements screens match the current app UI (no redesign). (TFA-94700 AC 6)

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Visual lane profiles desktop, pixel7 and iphone15 (WebKit)

When Run axe on / signed out, on the agreements screen for a fresh account that has not accepted, and on /settings

Then No WCAG 2 A/AA violations. Both checkboxes have accessible names equal to their visible text. Continue and Decline are named buttons. The code field has a label. Nothing is cut off or overlapped at phone width. The Settings and agreements screens look like the rest of the current app (no redesign).

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): visual-checks.ts axe count = 0, plus the existing overflow / truncated / tap checks = 0 per screen and profile. T12 (TFA-94700 AC 6): a person compares the Settings and agreements screenshots with the current app screens; vision-review findings need a human.

Where it ran: local visual lane (screenshots + axe); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (blocked)

S21 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-01.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Suggestion · our own check · environment local · tickets TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94700 ready for qa

On the sign-in code step 'Resend code' and 'Use a different email' are 16 px-tall text buttons that fail the tap-size rule in iPhone emulation, the sign-in footer and the Send-code button fail AA contrast, and Settings has an unnamed close (X) button.

Evidence: allure 491bc916-…-result.json; runs/2026-10-14-local/visual/evidence/OAT-01_S21: 55 checks pass, 13 fail. The 297×16 buttons fail WCAG 2.5.8 in iPhone 15 WebKit emulation but pass in Chromium (Pixel 7), about 1 px apart, so confirm on a real iPhone. Field labels, checkbox names and Continue/Decline names pass. T12 (looks like the current app) is left to a person.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane visual.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); secondary: EXPLORATORY · Exploratory testing — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: visual.

UAT item: OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-01/S21

[2026-10-14 review] Re-run with the stricter 'covered' rule (a fixed layer over a fixed layer is high). — T12 (looks like the rest of the current app, no redesign) is a person's comparison; vision-review only lists suspicions.

Contrast: the 'Round Companion — Physician Access Only' footer and the Send-code button (white on teal) fail AA on sign-in; Settings has an unnamed close (X) button. Breaks the oracle 'axe count = 0 … tap = 0 per screen and profile'.

Evidence: 9 attached; 1 not attached:

  • visual/evidence/OAT-01_S21 — a folder (27 items), not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev; the agreements screen also needs a fresh account that has not accepted, which dev cannot make.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
